purpose: Establish a full-data full-mask baseline before compute-matched low-budget outer-boundary constraint experiments
target: Complete solid mask of every Technic friction pin, part 2780; air, voids and other part types are background
target_rationale: Small familiar connectors present in all seven assemblies; slots, ridges, narrow interfaces and contacts make voxel boundary errors measurable
model: MONAI SwinUNETR, spatial_dims=3, feature_size=24, one input channel and two output classes, from scratch
split_rationale: Freeze five varied full assemblies for training, a separate car for selection and another for final testing before any model results; no slice or patch split across sets
full_data_definition: All native voxels and all target annotations from all five training assemblies are eligible for sampling; validation and test labels are held out
storage: Lossless chunked HDF5: gzip or LZF with byte shuffle for CT, original instance labels preserved; every CT and instance-label voxel verified against full source-array hashes; disposable ZIP removed to fit quota
normalization: Fixed raw uint16 / 65535, with no fitted validation or test statistics
patch_sampling: Uniform training assembly; 50% target-instance-centered with jitter, 30% other-part-centered, 20% uniform native volume
augmentations: Independent axis flips, 90-degree rotations, intensity scale 0.9-1.1, shift +/-0.05; paired image/mask spatial transforms
loss: Equally weighted foreground soft Dice plus two-class cross entropy
checkpoint_selection: Pooled foreground Dice over fixed seeded native validation ROIs: up to 64 target, 38 other-part and 26 uniformly sampled locations; overlapping voxels may recur; never test-selected
final_evaluation: Best selected checkpoint; dense entire native validation and test grids using Gaussian sliding-window inference, overlap 0.25 and CPU output accumulation
metrics: Dice in 2-native-voxel ground-truth morphological boundary band
Dice in boundary band near other pieces
Per-pin local-box Dice using all target pins in each box
boundary_units: Native voxels; no medical or physical spacing inferred
walltime_policy: Checkpoint every epoch; if the training time guard is reached, mark incomplete and retain checkpoint for a later explicitly guarded resume
submission_policy: Submit only if the entire user Slurm queue is empty immediately before sbatch; never cancel an unrelated job
resume_reproducibility: RNG and optimizer states are saved; restarted worker augmentation streams are not guaranteed bit-identical to an uninterrupted job
interpretation_limit: Seven assemblies are seven distinct simulated volumes, despite many pin instances. This baseline establishes feasibility, not evidence of constraint gains. CT is simulated, not physically acquired. Future constraint comparisons must use matched splits, seeds, annotation availability and compute budgets.
